title: QMBL - the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard
description: A record of published variational ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians. Data entries are ranked by energy and carry an explicit bound_type (variational, projected, extrapolated and exact results). This snapshot contains 341 Hamiltonian instances and 1215 data points. To achieve SOTA on the leaderboard a record has to exist under the rules in RULES.md.
